entities.summary: Islamic Awakening, a transformative movement in Saudi Arabia (1979–1990). Emerged from Saudi Arabia funds and supports the Afghan mujahideen against the Soviet Union and Seizure of the Grand Mosque in Mecca by Juhayman al-Otaybi.
